mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_notify_mute WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND source_code = #{sourceCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_notify_mute (user_id, source_code, enabled, mute_email, mute_server_chan, mute_wxpusher) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sourceCode}, #{enabled}, #{muteEmail}, #{muteServerChan}, #{muteWxpusher}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enabled = VALUES(enabled), mute_email = VALUES(muteEmail), mute_server_chan = VALUES(muteServerChan), mute_wxpusher = VALUES(muteWxpusher)
